timeline.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
timeline.threshold: Age checks for adult / sensitive content
timeline.summary: Platforms rolled out face-scan or ID age checks for mature content under the Online Safety Act (e.g. Reddit from 14 July 2025; X and Discord from 25 July 2025; Spotify facial checks August 2025). Aylo shut off Pornhub for new United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland users on 2 February 2026 rather than keep operating under the regime.

timeline.threshold: Under 16 barred from covered social accounts
timeline.summary: Nationwide ban requiring covered platforms to prevent under-16s from holding accounts. Took effect 10 December 2025; later fine-doubling proposals followed evidence of bypasses. Separate eSafety age-assurance codes for adult content took effect 9 March 2026, prompting Pornhub to geo-block Australia.

timeline.threshold: Under-16 social accounts linked to guardian; reliable age verification
timeline.summary: Digital Statute of Children and Adolescents requires reliable age verification (no self-declaration alone) and linking under-16 social media accounts to a legal guardian.

timeline.threshold: Under 16 barred on designated high-risk platforms
timeline.summary: Gradual deactivation of under-16 accounts on high-risk platforms including YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, Bigo Live and Roblox.

timeline.threshold: Under 16; platforms must verify age or face fines
timeline.summary: Under-16 social media ban took effect 1 June 2026. Platforms must verify ages and remove under-16 accounts or face fines of up to RM1 million.

timeline.law: Under-15 social media ban + age verification
timeline.threshold: Under 15 barred; age verification + parental tools for older minors
timeline.summary: Parliament banned social media services for under-15s and required age-verification systems. Enters force six months after Official Gazette publication. Separate e-Devlet real-ID login for all users remained a draft as of April 2026.

French lawmakers voted on 21 July 2026 to ban under-15s from creating social media accounts, taking effect on 1 September 2026 with a four-month grace period for platforms to deactivate existing under-15 accounts using mandatory age verification. The law fixes no list of platforms: it covers any online social network service, exempting online encyclopedias, educational and scientific directories, free-software platforms and educational projects, and reaching YouTube and WhatsApp only for their social features. The Constitutional Council must still rule, which could delay it. Separate SREN-law age checks for adult sites are already enforced by Arcom, with Pornhub dark in France since July 2025.

timeline.threshold: Digital majority 16; name, address and NIP verification
timeline.summary: Digital age of majority 16 with parental consent for younger users. Platforms must verify full identity (name, address, Personal Identification Number), not a bare age check. 12-month transition to February 2027.

timeline.law: Cabinet resolution on children's social media access
timeline.threshold: Under 15 barred; digital ID / AI age checks
timeline.summary: Minimum age 15 for personal social accounts; robust verification including digital identity and AI-supported methods (no self-declaration). Phase one names X, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat and TikTok. 12-month transition to June 2027.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 164 adult-site age verification (2024) · HB 161 App Store Accountability Act (2026)
legislative_efforts.summary: HB 164 has required ID-based age verification on adult sites since 1 October 2024 (Pornhub geo-blocked the state instead of complying). HB 161, enacted February 2026, will require app stores to verify age categories and obtain parental consent for minors' downloads from 1 January 2027.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 2112 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires commercial sites with substantial sexual material harmful to minors to verify users are 18+ via government ID or transactional data. Aylo blocked Pornhub in Arizona rather than run ID checks.

legislative_efforts.title: Act 612 adult-site age verification (2023) · Social Media Safety Act (Act 689) + successors Acts 900/901 (2025)
legislative_efforts.summary: Act 612 (SB 66) age verification for porn sites has been in effect since August 2023 (Pornhub blocked). The Social Media Safety Act (Act 689/SB 396) was permanently struck down on 31 March 2025; replacement Act 901 was preliminarily enjoined 15 December 2025 and Act 900's under-16 age-verification/parental-consent regime followed on 20 April 2026 (NetChoice v. Griffin).

legislative_efforts.title: SB 976 Protecting Our Kids from Social Media Addiction Act · AB 1043 Digital Age Assurance Act
legislative_efforts.summary: After the Ninth Circuit's December 2025 ruling, SB 976's parental-consent rules for addictive feeds and default protections operate, with AG age-assurance regulations proposed 14 May 2026 and due by 1 January 2027. AB 1043 (signed October 2025) makes operating systems collect birth dates and send age-bracket signals to apps from 1 January 2027. The earlier AADC (AB 2273) remains partially enjoined.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 25-086 (vetoed) · HB 24-1136 youth warnings (enjoined) · SB 26-051 Age Attestation on Computing Devices
legislative_efforts.summary: Gov. Polis vetoed social-media regulation bill SB 25-086 in April 2025, and HB 24-1136's youth warning displays were preliminarily enjoined 6 November 2025 (NetChoice v. Weiser). Colorado pivoted to device-level checks: SB 26-051, signed 3 June 2026, requires operating systems to collect age brackets and signal them to apps from 1 January 2028.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 3 (2023) and SB 1295 (2025) minors' online safety duties
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented — design duties, no ID checks
legislative_efforts.summary: Imposes design and default-setting duties for minors' social media accounts (effective October 2024, expanded 1 July 2026) but stops short of a mandatory ID age-verification regime; no blanket age-verification law has been enacted.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 3 Online Protections for Minors (social media ban under 14 + adult-site age verification)
legislative_efforts.summary: Since 1 January 2025 HB 3 requires age verification on adult sites (Pornhub blocked Florida) and bans under-14 social media accounts with parental consent needed at 14–15. A district court enjoined the social-media provisions in June 2025, but the Eleventh Circuit stayed that injunction on 25 November 2025, letting Florida enforce while CCIA & NetChoice v. Uthmeier proceeds.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 351 (Act 463): adult-site age verification + under-16 social media parental consent
legislative_efforts.summary: SB 351's age verification for adult sites took effect 1 July 2025 (Pornhub blocked Georgia). Its social-media age-verification and under-16 parental-consent provisions were preliminarily enjoined on 26 June 2025 (NetChoice v. Carr); the Eleventh Circuit heard Georgia's appeal on 10 March 2026 and a ruling is pending.

legislative_efforts.title: H 498 adult-site age verification (2024) · HB 542 Stop Harms from Addictive Social Media Act (2026)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented — HB 542 in force from 1 July 2026
legislative_efforts.summary: H 498 has required age verification on adult sites since July 2024 (Pornhub blocked). HB 542, signed 2 April 2026 and effective 1 July 2026, requires large social platforms to verify all Idaho users' ages, obtain verifiable parental consent for under-16s, and disable addictive features for minors.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 17 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires adult sites to verify users are 18+; effective 1 July 2024 with enforcement resuming 16 August 2024 after the Seventh Circuit stayed a district-court injunction. Pornhub geo-blocked Indiana rather than run ID checks.

legislative_efforts.title: HF 864 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Signed by Gov. Reynolds in 2026, HF 864 requires sites distributing material harmful to minors to verify users are 18+. Aylo cut access to Pornhub, YouPorn and RedTube in Iowa on 30 June 2026, the eve of the law taking effect.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 394 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires age verification for sites where 25%+ of content is harmful to minors — one of the lowest thresholds in the US. Pornhub geo-blocked Kansas rather than comply.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 278 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires commercial adult sites to verify Kentucky users are 18+ via digital ID or government ID. Pornhub geo-blocked Kentucky in response.

legislative_efforts.title: Act 440 (2022) adult-site age verification · Act 456 social media (struck down) · HB 570/977 app stores
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented (adult sites) · Rejected (social media) · Scheduled (app stores, 1 Jul 2027)
legislative_efforts.summary: Act 440 (HB 142) made Louisiana the first US state to require ID checks for porn sites (1 January 2023); Pornhub complies via LA Wallet — the only state where it did not block — and lost ~80% of traffic. The Secure Online Child Interaction and Age Limitation Act (Act 456/SB 162) was struck down on summary judgment 15 December 2025 (NetChoice v. Murrill; appeal expected). The App Store Accountability Act (HB 570) was replaced by HB 977 in May 2026, resetting app-store age verification to 1 July 2027.

legislative_efforts.title: Maryland Kids Code (HB 603/SB 571)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented — design code, no ID checks
legislative_efforts.summary: Age-appropriate design code in effect since 1 October 2024 requiring best-interests design and data protection for minors, but no mandatory ID age verification; a court challenge is pending with no injunction entered. No adult-site age-verification law has been enacted.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 2346 adult-site age verification (2023) · HB 1126 Walker Montgomery Protecting Children Online Act (2024)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented (both) — HB 1126 under Fifth Circuit review
legislative_efforts.summary: SB 2346 has required age verification on adult sites since July 2023 (Pornhub blocked). HB 1126 requires all-user age verification and parental consent for minors on social platforms; it took effect in July 2025 after the Fifth Circuit stayed an injunction and the Supreme Court declined to intervene in August 2025. Bluesky went dark in Mississippi from 22 August to 8 December 2025, then returned as 18+-only with age checks. The Fifth Circuit re-heard NetChoice v. Fitch on 3 February 2026; a ruling is pending.

legislative_efforts.title: Attorney General rule 15 CSR 60-18 (Merchandising Practices Act)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented — regulation in effect since 30 November 2025
legislative_efforts.summary: The only state to impose adult-site age verification by regulation rather than statute: the AG rule requires site- and device-level age checks with immediate deletion of verification data, at up to $10,000/day in penalties. Pornhub blocked Missouri within hours of the rule taking effect; industry groups question the rule's statutory authority.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 544 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires adult sites to verify Montana users are 18+; Pornhub geo-blocked the state. A separate design-code law for minors (SB 297) took effect 1 October 2025 without litigation.

legislative_efforts.title: LB 1092 adult-site age verification (2024) · LB 383 Parental Rights in Social Media Act (2025)
legislative_efforts.summary: LB 1092 age checks for porn sites have applied since July 2024 (Pornhub blocked). LB 383 — age verification plus parental consent for all under-18 social media accounts — was preliminarily enjoined days before its 1 July 2026 start (NetChoice v. Hilgers); only ancillary provisions such as parental activity logs survived. A separate design-code law (LB 504, amended by LB 838) remains in effect.

legislative_efforts.title: SAFE For Kids Act (S7694A) · Safe By Design Act (2026)
legislative_efforts.summary: The SAFE For Kids Act requires age assurance and parental consent before minors get addictive feeds or night-time notifications; the AG proposed implementing rules on 15 September 2025 (comments closed 1 December 2025) and the law bites 180 days after final rules — late 2026 at the earliest. The Safe By Design Act, signed 26 May 2026, adds further minor-safety duties from 1 January 2027. No adult-site ID law has been enacted.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 8 (PAVE Act) adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires commercial adult sites to verify age via government ID or commercial verification data. Pornhub geo-blocked North Carolina rather than comply.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 1561 adult-site age verification (2025) · SB 2380 device/app-store age signals
legislative_efforts.summary: HB 1561 has required adult-site age verification since 1 August 2025 (Pornhub blocked). Companion law SB 2380 goes further from 1 August 2026, requiring device makers and app stores to determine users' ages and transmit age signals so mature content is filtered for minors.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 96 adult-site age verification (2025) · Parental Notification by Social Media Operators Act (2023)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented — social-media consent law revived on appeal, June 2026
legislative_efforts.summary: HB 96's age-verification duty for adult sites took effect 30 September 2025, though Aylo argues its sites fall outside the law's 'interactive computer service' carve-out and has not blocked Ohio. The 2023 parental-consent law for under-16 social accounts, permanently enjoined in April 2025, was revived on 18 June 2026 when the Sixth Circuit reversed and ordered judgment for the state (NetChoice v. Yost), holding NetChoice lacked standing and the law survives scrutiny.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 1959 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires adult sites to verify Oklahoma users are 18+ with ID-based checks. Pornhub geo-blocked Oklahoma in response.

legislative_efforts.title: H 3424 adult-site age verification (2024) · H 3431 Social Media Regulation Act (2026)
legislative_efforts.summary: H 3424 has required adult-site age verification since 1 January 2025 (Pornhub blocked). The Social Media Regulation Act (H 3431), effective 5 February 2026, requires commercially reasonable age verification of account holders from 1 March 2026 and parental consent for minors, alongside design-code duties. NetChoice sued on 9 February 2026 but no injunction has been entered.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 1053 adult-site age verification · SB 180 app-store bill (failed)
legislative_efforts.summary: HB 1053 has required adult sites to verify age since 1 July 2025; Pornhub geo-blocked South Dakota. An App Store Accountability bill (SB 180) was rejected in committee in February 2025.

legislative_efforts.title: Protect Tennessee Minors Act (SB 1792) · Protecting Children from Social Media Act (HB 1891)
legislative_efforts.summary: Both laws took effect 1 January 2025: SB 1792 requires adult-site age verification (Pornhub blocked Tennessee), and HB 1891 requires social platforms to verify ages and get parental consent for minors. A preliminary injunction against the social-media law was denied in June 2025 (NetChoice v. Skrmetti); the Sixth Circuit heard the appeal on 4 February 2026.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 1181 adult-site age verification · SB 2420 App Store Accountability Act · HB 18 SCOPE Act
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented (HB 1181, SB 2420) · SCOPE Act partly enjoined
legislative_efforts.summary: HB 1181's ID checks for porn sites were upheld by the US Supreme Court in FSC v. Paxton (27 June 2025), the landmark ruling that triggered the national wave; Pornhub has blocked Texas since March 2024. SB 2420 makes Apple and Google verify age categories and parental consent for app downloads: enjoined in December 2025, revived by a Fifth Circuit stay in May 2026, and left in force by the Supreme Court on 6 July 2026 pending an expedited August merits hearing. Parts of the SCOPE Act's monitoring-and-filtering duties remain enjoined on appeal.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 287 adult-site age verification · Minor Protection in Social Media Act · App Store Accountability Act (SB 142/HB 498)
legislative_efforts.status: Implemented (adult sites) · Rejected (social media enjoined) · Scheduled (app stores, 6 May 2027)
legislative_efforts.summary: SB 287 made Utah the first state Pornhub blacked out (May 2023) and remains in force. The Social Media Regulation Act and its 2024 replacement (SB 194/HB 464) are preliminarily enjoined (NetChoice v. Brown; Tenth Circuit argued November 2025). The first-in-nation App Store Accountability Act (SB 142, 2025) was amended by HB 498 in March 2026: obligations now start 6 May 2027 and enforcement is by private suit only, after which the CCIA dropped its challenge.

legislative_efforts.title: H.121 (vetoed 2024) · Age-Appropriate Design Code Act (Act 63, 2025)
legislative_efforts.summary: Gov. Scott vetoed the 2024 data-privacy/kids-code bill H.121. The stand-alone Age-Appropriate Design Code Act signed June 2025 imposes minor-safety design duties (age estimation, not ID verification) from 1 January 2027. No adult-site age-verification law has been enacted.

legislative_efforts.title: SB 1515 adult-site age verification (2023) · SB 854 under-16 social media time limits (2025)
legislative_efforts.summary: SB 1515 has required adult-site age verification since July 2023 (Pornhub blocked Virginia). SB 854 — requiring platforms to age-verify users and default under-16s to one hour per app per day absent parental consent — took effect 1 January 2026 but was preliminarily enjoined on 27 February 2026 (NetChoice v. Jones); the state is appealing.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 4412 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires sites with substantial material harmful to minors to verify age via WV Mobile ID, government ID or transactional data, with $10,000-per-violation penalties. Aylo blocked Pornhub in West Virginia on the effective date, making it the 24th blocked state.

legislative_efforts.title: AB 105 adult-site age verification (vetoed)
legislative_efforts.summary: AB 105 passed both chambers with bipartisan support but Gov. Evers became the first US governor to veto an adult-site age-verification bill, citing 'intrusion into the personal privacy of Wisconsin residents' and calling instead for device-based age checks.

legislative_efforts.title: HB 43 adult-site age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Requires adult sites to verify Wyoming users are 18+ and, unusually, applies without a minimum share-of-content threshold. Pornhub geo-blocked Wyoming in response.

legislative_efforts.title: No age-verification law enacted (Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Washington)
legislative_efforts.status: No law — proposals only in several states
legislative_efforts.summary: As of July 2026 these states have no adult-site, social-media or app-store age-verification mandate in force or scheduled. Bills are pending in several — e.g. Michigan's HB 4938 (with a controversial VPN-blocking clause) sits in committee and Minnesota's HF 1875 remains unpassed — while the rest have seen proposals fail or none advance.

legislative_efforts.title: Bill C-34 Safe Social Media Act
legislative_efforts.summary: Would require platforms to prohibit accounts for under-16s, with possible exemptions if strong child-safety safeguards are demonstrated. Introduced June 2026; still needs parliamentary approval.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-16 social media access + mandatory age verification
legislative_efforts.summary: Government plans to ban under-16 access and force platforms to implement mandatory age-verification systems as part of a broader child online-safety agenda.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-15 social media ban with age tools
legislative_efforts.summary: Cross-party support for barring under-15s from social media, paired with digital evidence / age-verification tooling. Targeted towards mid-2026 lawmaking.

legislative_efforts.title: EU age-verification blueprint and Jutland Declaration
legislative_efforts.summary: Commission age-verification app pilots and political push for privacy-preserving age checks and a digital legal age across platforms; many member states considering national under-15/16 limits in parallel.

legislative_efforts.title: Under-13 ban; parental consent 13–15 via Digital Mobile Key
legislative_efforts.summary: Assembly approved a framework banning under-13 accounts and requiring verified parental consent for 13–15s via Digital Mobile Key, with large fines for non-compliance; final steps still tracked as pending full implementation.

legislative_efforts.title: Draft decree on under-16 social media and online gaming accounts
legislative_efforts.status: Draft — in consultation, not yet adopted
legislative_efforts.summary: Draft amendments to Vietnam's internet governance rules would verify every social media and gaming account against a legally authenticated phone number or personal identification number, and require under-16 accounts to be registered and supervised by a parent or guardian. Platforms would have to identify child users by technical means and serve age-appropriate content; under-16s would be barred from posting, commenting or reacting, and game operators would cap them at 60 minutes a day per publisher. Discussed at a Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism consultation workshop on 24 July 2026; not finalised and open to revision before adoption.
